set.body:
Confirmed baseline failure: the DMS sample-face-minus-scene statistic is 462.2342450591221 versus historical R 980.8491718335549; the fixed-effects and shape statistics also disagree. All observations reproduce without the ownership patch. The 50-column structural construction still passes.
Files: tools/r-parity/generate_dms_receipt.R, finalize_dms_receipt.py, modules/fit/shared/src/test/scala/scalafim/fmri/fit/fixtures/DmsRFixture.scala (or a separately named corrected variant), DelayedMatchToSampleDslScenarioSuite.scala, docs/scenarios/fixtures and manifest.json, declared reference locks/receipt registration as needed.
Follow docs/audits/spmg-correction.md and spmg-correction-source.json. Do not overwrite/relabel the old locked v1 receipt as if it certified corrected science. Generate a new corrected variant from the independently corrected R sources, loaded via pkgload before fmridesign; use DMS_RECEIPT_OUT and DMS_SCALA_OUT to generate into temporary paths first. Bind it to exact source hashes/revisions and a declared approved reference lock.
Compare constructed task matrices and scaling conventions before fit output. Then compare per-run fits, pooling/covariance, T/F ranks and all seven semantic hypotheses. Resolve mismatches at their first differing stage; do not copy ScalaFIM fit results into expected values. If a scientific discrepancy remains, record it as a blocker with a minimal numerical case.
Acceptance: the public DMS scenario retains 2+24+12+12 columns, source/phase identity and all hypotheses; new independent numerical evidence passes the same justified tolerances on fitJVM and fitJS. Historical receipt is retained and marked historical in metadata, corrected active receipt regenerates cleanly, manifest and check_receipts.py agree, and tools/docs/check_first_level_docs.py --check passes. No reverting the SPMG correction or loosening tolerances.
set.title: P4.4l: qualify a corrected-SPMG DMS design and inference receipt
